title: Leafnode connections can corrupt shared user permissions
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server supports leafnode connections and subject permissions for configured users.

### Problem Description

Leafnode connection handling could modify shared user permissions, allowing subject restrictions to be bypassed. Concurrent access to those permissions could also cause server crashes, memory disclosure or memory corruption. The reporter demonstrated code execution on local test builds. The issue affects leafnode listeners that authenticate against configured users with subject permissions.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.10 and v2.15.3. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * Report reference: GHSA-p849-62j6-rhc5
